requirements.text: Propose extending the advance-booking window to 30 calendar days.
requirements.quote: Allow reservations to start up to thirty calendar days after submission.
requirements.speaker: Jun
requirements.note: The approved window is 14 calendar days for every role; the change still needs approval. Recurring reservations were withdrawn.

requirements.text: Retain the three-consecutive-day maximum reservation duration.
requirements.quote: Keep the maximum duration at three consecutive calendar days.
requirements.speaker: Jun

requirements.text: Let members subscribe to email availability alerts for a chosen item and interval.
requirements.quote: Let members subscribe to an email when a selected item and date interval become available.
requirements.speaker: Jun
requirements.note: The baseline excludes waitlist alerts. Email links must not reserve automatically; subscription expiry is unresolved.

requirements.text: Allow members to unsubscribe from availability alerts.
requirements.quote: members must be able to unsubscribe.
requirements.speaker: Jun

expected_stories.title: Subscribe to slot availability emails
expected_stories.i_want: subscribe to email alerts for a selected item and interval and cancel my subscription
expected_stories.so_that: I can try booking when a slot opens
acceptance_criteria: Given an active subscription, when the selected interval becomes available, then the subscriber receives an email with a portal link and no automatic reservation is created.
Given a subscription, when its member unsubscribes, then subsequent matching availability events do not send alerts to that subscription.

questions: When should an availability subscription expire?
